priorStatuses.title: Handle missing cache entries before trimming

findings.title: [P1] Do not write issued tokens to application logs
findings.body: Every call with a real bearer/session token sends the raw credential to stdout via `console.log`, exposing it to log collectors and anyone with log access.

findings.title: [P2] Restrict post-login redirects to trusted destinations
findings.body: An absolute or protocol-relative returnUrl now sends the browser to an arbitrary external origin. If this value is derived from a login request, an attacker can construct a trusted-site login link that redirects users to a phishing destination; require a same-origin relative path or validate against an allowlist.
